ui.setupHelp:
1. In Hudu go to **Admin > API Keys**, then **+ New API Key** (top right).
2. Name it `conduit-mcp`, scope **Full Access**. Optionally limit it to specific companies. Password access can stay off, no tool reads passwords.
3. Copy the key into the field below.
4. Article writes stay off until the toggles below enable create/update and archive.

settings.label: Base URL
settings.help: Your Hudu instance URL, e.g. https://docs.yourcompany.com

settings.label: API key
settings.help: API key from Hudu Admin -> API Keys

settings.label: Enable article writes
settings.help: enables create and update of KB articles
